builder_lesson: A successful training job is not enough evidence to justify more compute. When the next decision is uncertain, buy the cheapest discriminating information first. Preserve true holdout semantics, reduce stochastic measurement variance without contaminating the split, and use a frozen probe to separate representation quality from fine-tuning capacity.
